counterfactual_missing_items: No evidence of pre-excitation or AV nodal reentrant tachycardia

decisive_items: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
Superiorly directed P waves (negative in leads II, III, and aVF)
Long RP interval (RP interval > PR interval)
response.rationale: R2 directly matches the ECG criteria for atrial tachycardia, including regular narrow complex tachycardia, superiorly directed P waves, and long RP interval. Other candidates either provide non-specific associations (R3, R4) or address unrelated findings (R1) or are redundant completions (C1).
